messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened PR #4827 changing autoscale TF for inference workloads. Summary: add a provisioner with altered weight for inference, reduce HPA CPU target for some ml services, rename Vault secret path, and adjust node consolidation settings. I ran a local plan but want a quick sanity check before merge: https://git.company/internal/pr/4827 :eyes:

ash: :eyes: on it now. Quick q — is the weight change intended to bias capacity toward inference over batch? Also which workloads depend on the scale-down buffer? Setting scaleDownBufferSeconds to 0 could cause immediate consolidation and flapping.

sam: Skimmed the TF diffs. Two things to call out: (1) the Vault secret path rename will break pods mounting the secret via CSI if we don't migrate/mount both paths during rollout; (2) lowering HPA target from 70 -> 60 will increase replica counts for CPU-bound models. Suggest canary first (ml-canary namespace) so we can measure tail latency and cache miss impacts.

olivia: Agree on canary. From staging traces, lowering to 60% bumped replicas ~20-30% for encoder/transformer traces. More pods = more KV cache shards and higher cold-cache latency. Maybe target only `encoder` pods initially.

maya: Good call — the current TF change targets pods with label `app in (encoder,transformer)` but I can restrict to `encoder` only. For secrets my plan was to add a migration job to copy old path -> new path and update CSI mounts after the copy. Example HPA patch I'm proposing:
```
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: encoder-deployment
  minReplicas: 2
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 60
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
```
Thoughts?

ash: Migration job sounds right. Consider applying blue/green for secret mounting: create new secret path, update CSI driver to accept both paths (or dual-mount), then rotate. Also document rollback steps.

infra-bot: terraform plan: 3 to add, 2 to change, 1 to destroy. Key snippets:
```
+ resource "karpenter_provisioner" "inference" {
  weight = 0.7
  # current scaleDownBufferSeconds = 0 in PR
}
- resource "karpenter_provisioner" "default" {
  weight = 1.0 -> 0.3
}
~ aws_ssm_parameter.vault_path "ml_secrets" {
  name: "/old/path" -> "/new/path"
}
```
No API downtime expected but watch mount failures.

sam: :thumbsup: If plan looks sane, gate merge behind: (1) staging canary deployed; (2) smoke tests for inferencing latency; (3) monitor pod churn for 30m. Also add `stabilizationWindowSeconds` to HPA to avoid oscillations (you included that — good).

olivia: Also enforce `minReplicas: 2` for encoder to avoid cold-start penalties. And bump scaleDownBufferSeconds from 0 to at least 60s so Karpenter won't immediately consolidate under transient load.

maya: I'll update the PR: restrict HPA selector to `encoder` only, set `minReplicas: 2`, `stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60`, and change `scaleDownBufferSeconds` to 60. I'll add a migration Job manifest for the Vault path and a playbook note describing rollout + revert steps. Will push changes and ping for another quick review.

ash: :rocket: ping when updated. Add a short script in the playbook for rolling back provisioner weight (terraform rollback steps or how to revert the provisioner resource).

maya: Will do. Thanks everyone :heart:
